description.en: Dance and movement by Mytam Mayo-Smith

motionAlt.en: Dancer in motion, bending toward the studio floor

floorAlt.en: Dancer stretching on the studio floor

body.en: Movement stands at the center of Tidal Rhythms. As a way to reconnect, to our bodies, our emotions, our identities and ancestries, to one another, and to the world around us.

blurb.en: A slow process for deeper healing.
A collective practice for inner freedom.
A structured practice for embodied flow.

p1.en: My work is centered on creating shared moments where we can be present, sensitive, creative together; where we can reflect on the cultures we are part of and our ways of seeing.

p2.en: The co-created workshops are primarily based on movement, collective dialogue, and musical soundscapes to reflect on a variety of connected topics such as patriarchy, mental health, and ecology. I have also offered dance as therapy, for domestic violence and sexual violence survivors in an institutional framework.

p3.en: Dance, movement, is an integral part of the workshops. I see movement as a way to reconnect to our body, to the persons that surround us, to the life that surrounds us, and to the nature we may not always see, but can feel.

p4.en: Personally, dancing is a practice of decolonization. Of Vietnamese and U.S. origins, I feel the legacy of colonialism, racism, and war. Through dance, I find the space to embody, and release.

trainingsList.en:
• Authentic flow 200H training Portugal, July 2023
  • Body-Mind-Centering (BMC) 144H training with Tamara Milla Vigo France, 2022
  • "Fundamentals in Dance-movement therapy", 32H training with Benoit Lesage France, February 2021
  • Dance-rhythm therapy 50H training with France Schott-Billmann France, October 2021
  • Masters in Interdisciplinary approaches to research and education - Learning Sciences - Center for Interdisciplinary research (now Learning Planet Institute), Université de Paris France, 2019-2021
    • Masters thesis: "Examining trauma-informed care: University students’ mental health experiences and strategies of mental health care during the COVID-19 pandemic"
    • Thesis presented at two conferences:

      "Colloque du Care", Montpellier, France, November 2021

      "Colloque Numérique et pandémie. Les enjeux d’éthique un an après", online, July 2021

    • Research project and workshop creation: what is collective trauma, and can we heal it through somatic therapies?
  • Contemporary dance practice since childhood, improvisation for +7 years
